finding.expected: Keep the fix inside TASK-181 scope. Selection must accept either a real DecisionPacket object or a strict-equivalent full Decision Packet v1 mapping whose closed field set and packet_fingerprint are internally consistent before any return-contract metadata cross-binding occurs. Add regression tests proving that partial mappings, extra fields, stale/mismatched packet fingerprints and metadata substitution fail closed while an exact full mapping and DecisionPacket object select the same return contract/ref. Do not add repository discovery, provider logic, lifecycle authority or a second TASK/REMEDIATION/REPAIR candidate validator.
finding.issue: select_return_contract accepts a partial mapping that contains only the protocol marker plus the five return-contract metadata fields. It does not require the supplied mapping to be a complete strict-equivalent AIOS_DECISION_PACKET v1 and does not verify packet_fingerprint. The focused tests intentionally construct such partial mappings. Therefore a fabricated or truncated mapping can select a return contract as if it were the exact Decision Packet required by TASK-181, weakening the exact-subject/substitution boundary that BP5-P2B is supposed to rely on.
